variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished original Chinese title logo for an independent historical narrative game titled exactly "逆转五丈原". Transparent background, isolated logo only, wide landscape composition with generous clean outer margin. Design direction A: heroic but restrained historical cinema calligraphy, five large accurately written simplified Chinese characters in one compact horizontal line, left to right 逆 转 五 丈 原, all equally legible and all present. Strong crafted brush lettering with substantial readable strokes, controlled dry-brush edges and only sparse interior distress. The first two characters have an ascending energy; one restrained vermilion brush sweep turns back upward under the beginning of the title to suggest reversing fate. Main lettering deep charcoal ink #182326, accent muted vermilion #803E36. The game is about entering Three Kingdoms historical tragedies and changing outcomes through dialogue, evidence and choices; the emotional tone is gravitas, regret and human resolve. High-end Chinese historical film title treatment, not fantasy martial arts. Flat two-color vector-friendly silhouette, no photoreal background, no scenic illustration, no literal arrows, no giant ornamental swashes, no swords, dragons, golden bevels, glossy 3D, magic, sparks, fan illustration, English, slogans, extra text, labels, borders or watermark. Prioritize elegant bespoke lettering and readable negative space at small sizes. This is a usable title wordmark, not a poster or brand presentation sheet.

Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished original Chinese game logo, exactly "逆转五丈原", isolated on a genuinely transparent background, wide horizontal lockup. Design direction B: a memorable simple bronze oil-lamp emblem on the left, paired with beautifully designed highly legible custom Chinese lettering on the right. The oil lamp emblem is a shallow ancient Chinese bronze bowl on a short stem and broad low foot, with a single small flame. Integrate one elegant open circular return curve into the lamp emblem to suggest time returning; it must remain a clean compact graphic, not a clock, arrow, ouroboros, Buddhist symbol or magic ring. Wordmark: all five simplified Chinese characters 逆 转 五 丈 原 in one line, strong refined angular Chinese inscription-inspired typography with subtle flared terminals, good spacing and restrained handcrafted personality. All characters large and readable, do not substitute a lamp for a letter. Deep mountain-charcoal #233438 lettering; emblem muted aged bronze #9A7847 and a tiny dark vermilion flame #803E36. Flat solid fills with clear silhouettes; no 3D rendering, gradients, shadows or photographic textures. Emotional tone: an intimate Three Kingdoms historical narrative game about keeping hope alive and changing tragic outcomes; restrained, mature and humane. Emblem must work alone as a small app mark while full wordmark works on an exhibition wall and title screen. Clean generous transparent margins. No English, no subtitle, no additional Chinese, no variant sheet, no sample background, no watermark, no swords, dragons or fantasy ornaments.

Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE original premium Chinese historical narrative game logo reading exactly "逆转五丈原" with a transparent background, wide landscape format. Direction C: military seal and carved historical inscription. A compact dark vermilion square seal at left contains the accurately readable two simplified Chinese characters "逆转" stacked vertically in white negative space. To its right, the three characters "五丈原" are very large deep ink charcoal #1C2B2C, one horizontal row in custom monumental Chinese clerical-script-inspired lettering, broad sturdy strokes with subtle angular chiseled terminals. The seal height approximately matches the height of the three main letters, so the five characters read naturally together left to right as the one game title 逆转五丈原. Preserve correct modern simplified character skeletons, not invented pseudo-seal script. Seal border has one small intentional opening with a short upward-turning end, suggesting changing a fixed fate, but no arrow symbol. Minimal, graphic, almost solid-color shapes with very restrained worn edges; mature historical gravity, excellent strong silhouette and readability, no excessive distress. The game is about changing Three Kingdoms tragedies through choices, evidence, persuasion and rescue. This mark must work on a public exhibition, print collateral and inside the game. Exact title only, no supplementary words, slogans, English, labels, secondary seals, landscape background, paper texture, mockup, photo, bevel, metallic glow, fantasy weapons or watermark. Generous clean transparent padding. Show only one completed logo.
